place_fields.summary: Historic dargah of Hazrat Khwaja Banda Nawaz Gesu Daraz, a major pilgrimage centre in Kalaburagi.
place_fields.best_time: Morning or early evening; listed hours are 05:00–20:00.

planning_attributes.description: A historic Sufi shrine associated with Hazrat Khwaja Banda Nawaz Gesu Daraz in Kalaburagi.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The saint settled in Gulbarga and spent the later part of his life there; the Karnataka district describes the dargah as an Indo-Saracenic building with Bahmani, Turkish and Iranian architectural influences.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located in Gulbarga City; the district government says it can be reached by auto or city bus.
local_name_variants: Hazrat Khwaja Banda Nawaz Gesu Daraz Dargah
planning_attributes.notes: The official dargah site lists the address on Dargah Road and provides visitor facilities including a guest house and resting areas.

place_fields.summary: Historic khanqah associated with Khwaja Banda Nawaz in Kailash Nagar, close to Gulbarga railway station.
place_fields.best_time: Morning or evening; listed hours are 07:00–22:00.

planning_attributes.description: A historical landmark and khanqah associated with Khwaja Banda Nawaz.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: A local place source reports that Khwaja Banda Nawaz performed zikr and stayed at the site for 20 years.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located in Kailash Nagar, Kalaburagi; the listed location is about 0.91 km from Gulbarga railway station.
planning_attributes.notes: The available place listing reports daily opening from 07:00 to 22:00.

place_fields.vibe: historic Shaiva temple and heritage site
place_fields.summary: Ancient Kaleshwara temple in Kalgi, part of a larger Chalukyan-era temple landscape noted for historic architecture and inscriptions.

planning_attributes.description: A historic Shiva temple at Kalgi in Kalaburagi district, associated with the region's Chalukyan-period temple complex.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Sources describe Kalgi's temples as Later/Kalyana Chalukya-period monuments; the Kaleshwara temple is associated with rare Shiva-linga traditions and inscriptions dating from the medieval period.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The temple is in Kalgi, Chittapur taluk, about 35–40 km east of Kalaburagi.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Heritage sources report that some surrounding Kalgi monuments are in a dilapidated state; visitors should avoid climbing or touching fragile structures.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates closely match independently published coordinates for the Neelakantha Kaleshwara temple in Kalgi.
